title: Surreal Cosmic Face
description: A large circular surreal face is split into four distinct quadrants against a grassy field at dusk. The left side shows a glowing yellow sun with a black slit eye and a white crescent moon, the top features a purple night sky with a black obelisk and stars, the right displays a bright full moon over green landscape, and the bottom right shows an orange sunset with a black sailboat. A large red crystalline maple leaf protrudes from the right side of the face, which has visible lips with teeth and a nose.
prompt: Surreal circular face split into four quadrants floating above a grassy field at twilight. Left quadrant contains a glowing golden sun with black slit eye and white crescent moon. Top quadrant shows dark purple night sky with tall black obelisk and stars. Right quadrant features a bright full moon over green hills. Bottom right shows orange sunset with black sailboat on water. A large faceted red crystalline maple leaf emerges from the right side. The face has realistic lips with teeth and a defined nose. Dramatic sky with clouds and distant hills in background, symbolic and mystical atmosphere.
